title: The Late Bus Stop
tagline: Dusk falls over the transit hub, and an unexpected stranger closes the distance.
learningGoal: Recognize boundary testing early, shift to illuminated staffed zones, and verify arrival protocols.

tipCard.title: Public Transit Shield
tipCard.rule: Always board through the illuminated front door near the driver and keep at least one trusted contact updated on your route.

title: The Follower
tagline: Footsteps match your pace along a quiet street as you head home.
learningGoal: Spot persistent pacing, cross to active illuminated stores, and refuse isolated detours.

tipCard.title: Distance & Public Sight
tipCard.rule: Never walk into blind alleys to hide. Move directly toward staffed stores, cashiers, and crowded sidewalks.

title: The Cab Ride
tagline: Your evening ride-share arrives. Verify safety protocols before entering.
learningGoal: Verify license plate and driver photo, ensure door locks function, and share live tracking.

tipCard.title: Ride-Share Check
tipCard.rule: Always ask 'Who are you picking up?' instead of giving your name first, and test the door handle immediately.

title: Online Friend
tagline: A player in your favorite gaming group begins asking for private photos and home addresses.
learningGoal: Recognize online grooming, protect personal identifiers, and use block/report features immediately.

tipCard.title: Digital Privacy Shield
tipCard.rule: Never share your school, full name, address, or personal images with online acquaintances.

title: Crowded Market
tagline: During a festival shopping rush, someone repeatedly invades your personal space.
learningGoal: Use a loud and clear 'NO!', draw natural bystander attention, and report to market security.

tipCard.title: Vocal Boundaries
tipCard.rule: A loud and firm refusal breaks silence and alerts everyone nearby. Never feel shy about protecting your space.

title: The Office Lift
tagline: An uncomfortable encounter inside an elevator at your workplace or college building.
learningGoal: Maintain physical distance near button panels, exit promptly on populated floors, and document incidents.

tipCard.title: Safe Elevator Protocol
tipCard.rule: Stand near the control panel so you can press the next floor button and step out whenever uncomfortable.

title: Party Night
tagline: Navigating a social gathering, keeping an eye on your beverage, and watching out with friends.
learningGoal: Practice the buddy system, never leave drinks unattended, and leave when instincts say so.

tipCard.title: The Buddy Code
tipCard.rule: Arrive together, check in frequently, and leave together. If your drink left your sight, get a fresh one.

title: Be the Hero for Someone Else
tagline: You spot a younger girl, Pihu, looking lost and distressed near the transit gate.
learningGoal: Offer calm bystander assistance, escort to authorized station staff, and avoid reckless solo escalation.

tipCard.title: Safe Bystander Action
tipCard.rule: Direct intervention is safest when you connect the person with official personnel or staff together.
